name: Check
description: Monitoring condition evaluated against the latest status of a server or instance.

name.label: Name
name.description: Condition generated from the status path, operator, and expected value.

object_class.label: Target class
object_class.description: Class of the server or instance evaluated by the check.
object_class.help: Automatically assigned from the related target.

object_id.label: Target ID
object_id.description: Identifier of the server or instance evaluated by the check.
object_id.help: Automatically assigned from the related target.

status_path.label: Status path
status_path.description: Dot-separated path of the value in the collected status data.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Status-data scope derived from the status path.
scope.help: Used to determine which status data must be collected for this check.

operator.label: Operator
operator.description: Comparison applied to the collected value.

check_value.label: Expected value
check_value.description: Value against which the collected status value is compared.
check_value.help: For membership operators, use a JSON array or comma-separated values.

value.label: Current value
value.description: Value read during the latest evaluation.

is_success.label: Successful
is_success.description: Whether the latest evaluation matched the expected condition.

alert_triggers_ids.label: Alert triggers
alert_triggers_ids.description: Alert triggers that use this check.

form.default.name: Check
form.default.description: Create or edit a monitoring check.
